The distinctive red sandstone gateway with domed corner pavilions and flanking minarets (e2, e4, e3) matches the iconic entrance of Badshahi Mosque in Lahore. The white minaret visible in the background (e3) belongs to the adjacent Lahore Fort/Roshnai Gate area. The large paved plaza (e9), crenellated boundary walls (e1, e5), and general architectural style are all consistent with this Mughal-era complex.
